title: Code quality tools training (SonarLint, IDE plugins), 3 days
summary: A training I delivered for Philips software teams.

feedback.themes: Participants most often valued depth of knowledge, hands-on demos and clear explanations. Suggestions centered on more hands-on practice.
quotes: Detailed Guidance during the session, Clear and Crisp acknowledgement of asked questions.
Its good to learn new tools like Sonarlint and how to use that for improving code quality and saving overall development time.
